name: Guess Who
summary: Two-player deduction game where each player tries to guess the other's hidden character by asking yes-or-no questions.
rules_text: Each player has a tray of 24 named faces and draws a secret Mystery Card from a shuffled deck, hidden from the opponent. On your turn you either ask a yes-or-no question about the opponent's mystery person (e.g., 'Does he have glasses?') or guess the identity. After a question, the opponent must answer truthfully yes or no, and you flip down all faces in your tray contradicted by that answer. You may not ask and guess on the same turn. If you guess the Mystery Card correctly you win immediately; if you guess incorrectly you lose immediately.
rating_reason: Deductive hidden face elimination, turn-based text attributes works
